footer.tagline: Structured learning — from zero to TOEIC/IELTS.

home.title: Learn English from a real foundation
home.subtitle: Whether you're starting over or prepping for tests: master 12 tenses first (no sign-in), then TOEIC/IELTS sets, quizzes with explanations, and AI feedback for writing & speaking.
home.phase1Text: Four tense groups, bilingual examples, random quizzes after each group.
home.phase2Text: Exam sets, 2 or 4 skills, mock registration, API v1 for mobile.
home.benefit1Text: We don't assume you already know grammar jargon.
home.benefit2Text: Study by group, EN–VI examples, practice after each group.
home.benefit3Text: TOEIC & IELTS mini sets, per-item scoring and feedback.
home.benefit4Text: XP and streaks encourage consistency without guilt.
home.faq1q: Do I need to sign in to learn the 12 tenses?
home.faq1a: No. Grammar and group quizzes work immediately; sign in for TOEIC/IELTS sets and server progress (expanding soon).
home.faq2q: How do TOEIC and IELTS differ here?
home.faq2a: TOEIC focuses on Listening & Reading (2 skills); IELTS adds Writing & Speaking with sample AI feedback.

guide.title: SEO guide (no technical background needed)
guide.intro: SEO controls how Google and social networks show your site name, description, and image when people search or share a link. Fill in text and images, then Save — the learner portal picks it up automatically.
guide.step1: Open Global: set site name, default title and description (about 60 characters for title, ~150 for description reads well on Google).
guide.step2: Under Favicon & logo: upload an image or paste an existing image URL. Logo = header menu; Favicon = browser tab icon.
guide.step3: Click Save. If the portal still looks old, use Clear SEO cache above and hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
guide.step4: Only when one page needs its own title: Pages tab → pick route → vi/en → fill → Save.
guide.step5: Preview tab: check how it may look on Google / social shares.
guide.step6: Validation tab: fix missing or duplicate titles.
guide.tabGlobal1: Site name: shown next to the logo in the header.
guide.tabGlobal2: Default title: blue headline on Google — short, with main keywords.
guide.tabGlobal3: Default description: gray text under the title — what learners get from the site.
guide.tabGlobal4: OG image: large image when sharing links (1200×630 px recommended).
guide.tabPagesBody: Most grammar/exam pages already derive titles from content. Override only for custom marketing copy per URL. Always pick the correct vi or en locale.
guide.tabTechnicalBody: Canonical base = your real website URL (e.g. https://yoursite.com). Enable Maintenance only during full-site maintenance (stops indexing).
guide.exampleBody: Title: "Learn English tenses | English Zero2Hero" · Description: "Grammar, TOEIC/IELTS for beginners — Vietnamese explanations, quizzes, and a clear roadmap."
guide.skipBody: JSON-LD, per-page canonical, long keyword lists — leave blank unless marketing asks for them.
guide.hintGlobal: Start here: title + description, upload logo/favicon, then Save. Amber character counts mean consider shortening.
guide.hintPages: Use only when a specific page needs a different title/description. Pick the route and vi/en locale.
guide.hintTechnical: Set canonical base when you have a production domain. Avoid Maintenance unless the site is down.
guide.hintPreview: Preview is indicative — use it to judge title/description length.
guide.hintValidate: The table lists suggestions; fix globals on the Global tab or overrides on the Pages tab.

fieldHelp.siteName: Brand name shown next to the logo in the learner header — keep it short.
fieldHelp.defaultTitle: Default browser tab / Google title (~60 chars). Used when a page has no custom title.
fieldHelp.defaultDescription: Gray snippet under the title on Google (~150 chars). Explain who it is for and the benefit.
fieldHelp.keywords: Optional extra keywords (less important than title/description). Comma-separated.
fieldHelp.ogTitle: Title when sharing to social apps. Empty = use default title.
fieldHelp.ogDescription: Description for social shares. Empty = use default description.
fieldHelp.ogImage: Large share image (1200×630 px recommended). Upload or paste a URL.
fieldHelp.favicon: Small icon in the browser tab. PNG/ICO via upload or URL.
fieldHelp.siteLogo: Logo in the learner header. Prefer transparent or square assets.
fieldHelp.orgLogo: Logo for Google structured data (Organization). Falls back to site logo if empty.
fieldHelp.orgName: Organization/brand name for Google — usually matches site name.
fieldHelp.routeKey: Pick which page gets a custom title/description (e.g. home, grammar, a tense).
fieldHelp.pageLocale: vi = Vietnamese, en = English. Configure each language separately.
fieldHelp.pageTitle: Title for the selected page only — overrides the global default when set.
fieldHelp.pageDescription: Description for the selected page only.
fieldHelp.canonicalPath: Preferred path on your site, e.g. /grammar/present-simple — usually leave empty.
fieldHelp.robotsIndex: On = allow Google to index this page. Off = hide from search.
fieldHelp.robotsFollow: On = crawlers may follow links on the page. Usually keep on.
fieldHelp.structuredData: Advanced JSON for Google — only if your SEO team provides it.
fieldHelp.canonicalBase: Root site URL (no trailing slash), e.g. https://yoursite.com — used for canonical URLs and sitemap.
fieldHelp.robotsDefaultFollow: Default: allow crawlers to follow links.
fieldHelp.maintenanceNoindex: Turn on during full-site maintenance to block indexing temporarily.
